title: R24 TABLESTYLE border override flags

source.specification: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1, §20.4.101.4
source.finding: Border group 90 defines six property overrides: border type 0x1, lineweight 0x2, linetype 0x4, color 0x8, invisibility 0x10, and double-line spacing 0x20.

implementation.behavior: The AC1024 TABLESTYLE writer admits the documented border override mask 0x3f for each border while preserving the existing supported border-value checks. Unknown bits remain rejected.

validation.result: Build passed; focused CTest passed 1/1. Generated ASCII/Binary controls set each documented override bit on one border, check group-90 position and typed readback, reject bit 0x40 with destination preservation, and verify same-adapter retry.

qualificationLimits: Generated codec controls do not qualify independent producer wire behavior.
Native border rendering and interpretation remain unqualified.
No whole-file DWG/DXF support claim is promoted.
